package aegis_pit

import (
	"chain"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	core "gno.land/p/g1tjs9agmvxqn4r245avwht57j8jgy5sapxq96ym/aegis_core"
	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
)

var (
	alice   = testutils.TestAddress("alice")  // owns fighter A
	bob     = testutils.TestAddress("bob")    // owns fighter B
	carol   = testutils.TestAddress("carol")  // bettor
	dave    = testutils.TestAddress("dave")   // bettor
	agentK  = testutils.TestAddress("agent")  // AI agent key
	hacker  = testutils.TestAddress("hacker") // injected recipient
	tavern  = testutils.TestAddress("tavern") // allowed recipient
	pkgAddr = chain.PackageAddress("gno.land/r/g1tjs9agmvxqn4r245avwht57j8jgy5sapxq96ym/aegis_pit/v2")
)

func setupFighters(cur realm) (int, int) {
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	a := RegisterFighter(cross(cur), "Ironclad", "gno.land/r/g1tjs9agmvxqn4r245avwht57j8jgy5sapxq96ym/ironclad", 1000)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	b := RegisterFighter(cross(cur), "Viper", "gno.land/r/g1tjs9agmvxqn4r245avwht57j8jgy5sapxq96ym/viper", 1000)
	return a, b
}

func TestRankedMatchFullFlow(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	testing.IssueCoins(pkgAddr, chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 1_000_000}})
	fa, fb := setupFighters(cur)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 1000}})
	mid := CreateMatch(cross(cur), fa, true)

	// same owner cannot join own match
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 1000}})
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "cannot fight yourself", func() {
		JoinMatch(cross(cur), mid, fa)
	})
	// wrong bond
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 999}})
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "bond must equal", func() {
		JoinMatch(cross(cur), mid, fb)
	})
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 1000}})
	JoinMatch(cross(cur), mid, fb)
	uassert.Equal(t, StatusLive, MatchStatus(mid))

	// bets
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 600}})
	PlaceBet(cross(cur), mid, 1)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(dave))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 400}})
	PlaceBet(cross(cur), mid, 2)

	// anti match-fixing: alice cannot bet against her own fighter
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 10}})
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "against their own fighter", func() {
		PlaceBet(cross(cur), mid, 2)
	})

	// commits
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{})
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	CommitMove(cross(cur), mid, core.CommitHash("SFG", "alice-salt-1"))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	CommitMove(cross(cur), mid, core.CommitHash("FGS", "bob-salt-123"))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "already committed", func() {
		CommitMove(cross(cur), mid, core.CommitHash("SSS", "bob-salt-123"))
	})

	// reveal before the lock is refused (nobody sees moves while bets are open)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "reveal opens after block", func() {
		Reveal(cross(cur), mid, "SFG", "alice-salt-1")
	})

	testing.SkipHeights(CommitWindow + 1)

	// betting is locked at the commit deadline
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 100}})
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "betting is locked", func() {
		PlaceBet(cross(cur), mid, 1)
	})
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{})

	// wrong salt
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "does not match", func() {
		Reveal(cross(cur), mid, "SFG", "wrong-salt-x")
	})
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	Reveal(cross(cur), mid, "SFG", "alice-salt-1")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	Reveal(cross(cur), mid, "FGS", "bob-salt-123")

	uassert.Equal(t, StatusResolved, MatchStatus(mid))
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, MatchWinner(mid))

	// pool 1000: carol (only winner bettor) gets 950, backers 30, season 20
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(950), CreditOf(carol))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), CreditOf(dave))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1000), CreditOf(alice)) // bond back
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1000), CreditOf(bob))   // bond back
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(30), BackerPending(fa, alice))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(20), SeasonFund())

	// trust only from ranked money
	uassert.True(t, TrustScore(alice) > TrustScore(bob))

	// Backer Tokens are a real GRC20, readable through the standard Teller
	tok := BackerToken(fa)
	uassert.Equal(t, "BACK1", tok.GetSymbol())
	uassert.Equal(t, "Ironclad Backer", tok.GetName())
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1000), tok.TotalSupply())
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1000), tok.BalanceOf(alice))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(BackerTokenID(fa), ".BACK1."))

	// backer token transfer settles dividends first
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	TransferBacker(cross(cur), fa, carol, 500)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1030), CreditOf(alice))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(500), BackerBalance(fa, carol))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), BackerPending(fa, carol))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(500), BackerToken(fa).BalanceOf(carol)) // moved on the GRC20 ledger

	// claim pays out
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	got := Claim(cross(cur))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(950), got)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), CreditOf(carol))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "nothing to claim", func() {
		Claim(cross(cur))
	})

	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("match/1"), "Combat log"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("fighters"), "First Blood"))
}

func TestSlashNoReveal(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	testing.IssueCoins(pkgAddr, chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 1_000_000}})
	fa, fb := setupFighters(cur)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 2000}})
	mid := CreateMatch(cross(cur), fa, true)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 2000}})
	JoinMatch(cross(cur), mid, fb)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 300}})
	PlaceBet(cross(cur), mid, 2)
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{})

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	CommitMove(cross(cur), mid, core.CommitHash("SSS", "salt-alice"))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	CommitMove(cross(cur), mid, core.CommitHash("GGG", "salt-bob-1"))
	testing.SkipHeights(CommitWindow + 1)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	Reveal(cross(cur), mid, "SSS", "salt-alice")
	// bob sees he would lose and refuses to reveal

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(dave))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "nothing to slash yet", func() {
		SlashNoReveal(cross(cur), mid)
	})
	testing.SkipHeights(RevealWindow + 1)
	before := CreditOf(alice)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(dave))
	SlashNoReveal(cross(cur), mid)

	uassert.Equal(t, StatusForfeit, MatchStatus(mid))
	uassert.Equal(t, before+4000, CreditOf(alice)) // both bonds
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(300), CreditOf(carol))  // bettors refunded
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("lab"), "never revealed"))
}

func TestFriendlyMatchNoBets(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	fa, fb := setupFighters(cur)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 1000}})
	mid := CreateMatch(cross(cur), fa, false)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 1000}})
	JoinMatch(cross(cur), mid, fb)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 10}})
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "no betting", func() {
		PlaceBet(cross(cur), mid, 1)
	})
}

func TestBoxPolicyAndExit(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	testing.IssueCoins(pkgAddr, chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 1_000_000}})
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 100}})
	box := CreateBox(cross(cur), agentK, string(tavern), "Tip", 30, 0)
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{})
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(100), BoxBalance(box))

	// prompt-injected agent tries to send to a hacker: hard revert
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(agentK))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "target not in allowlist", func() {
		BoxSpend(cross(cur), box, hacker, "Tip", 10)
	})
	// over cap
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(agentK))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "exceeds per-tx cap", func() {
		BoxSpend(cross(cur), box, tavern, "Tip", 31)
	})
	// wrong fn
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(agentK))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "function not in allowlist", func() {
		BoxSpend(cross(cur), box, tavern, "Drain", 1)
	})
	// stranger
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(hacker))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "not the box owner", func() {
		BoxSpend(cross(cur), box, tavern, "Tip", 1)
	})

	// soft variant logs to the lab and moves nothing
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(agentK))
	ok := GuardedSpend(cross(cur), box, hacker, "Tip", 10)
	uassert.False(t, ok)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(100), BoxBalance(box))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("lab"), "target not in allowlist"))

	// legit spend
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(agentK))
	BoxSpend(cross(cur), box, tavern, "Tip", 20)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(80), BoxBalance(box))

	// agent cannot exit; owner can
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(agentK))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "only the box owner", func() {
		EmergencyWithdraw(cross(cur), box)
	})
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	got := EmergencyWithdraw(cross(cur), box)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(80), got)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), BoxBalance(box))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(agentK))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "box closed", func() {
		BoxSpend(cross(cur), box, tavern, "Tip", 1)
	})
}

func TestBoxBet(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	testing.IssueCoins(pkgAddr, chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 1_000_000}})
	fa, fb := setupFighters(cur)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 1000}})
	mid := CreateMatch(cross(cur), fa, true)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 1000}})
	JoinMatch(cross(cur), mid, fb)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 100}})
	box := CreateBox(cross(cur), agentK, string(pkgAddr), "PlaceBet", 20, 0)
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{})
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(agentK))
	BoxBet(cross(cur), box, mid, 1, 20)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(80), BoxBalance(box))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(agentK))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "exceeds per-tx cap", func() {
		BoxBet(cross(cur), box, mid, 1, 21)
	})
}

func TestRenderRoutes(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render(""), "Aegis Pit"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("exit"), "EmergencyWithdraw"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("nope"), "404"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("match/999"), "404"))
}

# GnoSeal — Design

Verifiable onchain certificates on Gno.land. An issuer (hackathon, course,
event, bounty program) creates a completion record for a recipient address.
The record is non-transferable, publicly verifiable by anyone through the
realm's Render pages, and revocable only by its original issuer, with the
revocation reason written on chain.

- Module: `gno.land/r/g1vh79rcwdqd7m0dlt00slwa4lppwmn6fpytd9px/gnoseal`
- Package: `gnoseal` (this directory)
- Network: Onyx testnet, chain ID `onyx-1`
- Issuer/deployer address: `g1vh79rcwdqd7m0dlt00slwa4lppwmn6fpytd9px` (key `tavern-deployer`)
- Web surface after deploy: https://onyx.testnets.gno.land/r/g1vh79rcwdqd7m0dlt00slwa4lppwmn6fpytd9px/gnoseal

## Data model

Realm state (persisted automatically after each transaction):

```go
type Certificate struct {
    ID           uint64  // sequential, starts at 1, never reused
    Issuer       address // caller that created the certificate
    Recipient    address // bech32-validated at creation
    Title        string  // trimmed, 1..120 bytes
    Note         string  // 0..560 bytes
    Height       int64   // block height at issuance (runtime.ChainHeight)
    Revoked      bool    // set once by RevokeCertificate
    RevokeReason string  // 1..280 bytes once Revoked is true
}

var certs       []*Certificate          // certs[i] holds ID i+1 (issuance order)
var byRecipient = map[address][]uint64{} // recipient -> its certificate IDs, in issuance order
```

Certificates are never deleted or edited; revocation is a flag plus a
reason, so the full history stays auditable. There are no payments and no
transfer path: a certificate is a record, not an asset.

## Functions

Crossing functions (first parameter `realm`; callable via `gnokey maketx
call` and the gnoweb Actions tab). Caller identity is always
`cur.Previous().Address()`, per the current interrealm guidance (never
`chain/runtime/unsafe` stack-walking):

| Function | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `CreateCertificate(cur realm, recipient address, title string, note string) uint64` | Validates recipient (`address.IsValid`), title non-empty after trim and ≤ 120 bytes, note ≤ 560 bytes. Records the caller as issuer and the current block height. Returns the new sequential ID. |
| `RevokeCertificate(cur realm, id uint64, reason string)` | Panics unless the certificate exists, the caller is its original issuer, and it is not already revoked. Reason must be non-empty after trim and ≤ 280 bytes. Sets `Revoked` and stores the reason. |

Read functions (plain, callable via `vm/qeval` / `vm/qrender`):

| Function | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `Count() uint64` | Total certificates ever issued, including revoked ones. |
| `GetCertificate(id uint64) Certificate` | A copy of the certificate; panics (`gnoseal: certificate not found`) for ID 0 or an unissued ID. |
| `CertificatesOf(recipient address) []uint64` | Copy of the recipient's certificate IDs in issuance order (the `byRecipient` index). |

All validation panics happen before any state write, so a rejected call
leaves storage untouched.

## Render routes

`Render(path string) string` returns Markdown for gnoweb. Stored titles,
notes, and reasons are user-supplied, so they pass through
`sanitize.InlineText` (`gno.land/p/nt/markdown/sanitize/v0`) before being
written into the output; path segments are never echoed raw. Bad routes and
bad IDs render friendly pages instead of panicking.

| Path | Page |
| --- | --- |
| `""` | Intro, total issued, lookup hints, and the most recent certificates (newest first, up to 20), each linking to its detail page and marked if revoked. |
| `cert/<id>` | One certificate in full: title, recipient, issuer, issuance block height, status (Valid / Revoked), revoke reason when revoked, note when present, and a link to the recipient's collection page. Unknown or non-numeric IDs show "Certificate not found". |
| `addr/<address>` | All certificates issued to that address (newest first) with links. Invalid addresses and addresses without certificates get a clear message. |
| anything else | "Unknown page" with a link home. |

Links use the gnoweb form `/r/g1vh79rcwdqd7m0dlt00slwa4lppwmn6fpytd9px/gnoseal:cert/<id>`
(resp. `:addr/<address>`).

## Dependencies

- Realm code imports only the stdlib (`chain/runtime`, `strings`,
  `strconv`) plus `gno.land/p/nt/markdown/sanitize/v0` for Render output
  sanitization. That package is present on Onyx (its file list answers over
  the Onyx RPC).
- Test files additionally import `gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0` (with its deps
  `gno.land/p/nt/ufmt/v0` and `gno.land/p/onbloc/diff/v0`) to assert
  cross-call aborts via the VM's `revive` mechanism.
- Local resolution note: this VM cannot reliably download packages over
  RPC (the local relay intermittently 502s and direct TLS fails), so the
  four packages above were seeded into the local mod cache
  (`~/.config/gno/pkg/mod/`) from the official clone's `examples/` tree,
  together with their `.markers` entries (marker name = the package's
  derived bech32 address). That mirrors exactly what `gno mod download`
  would have written. If the cache is wiped, re-seed the same way or run
  `gno mod download -remote-overrides "gno.land=http://127.0.0.1:26657"`
  with the relay up and retry until it completes.

## Tests

`gno test .` — 14 tests, all passing; `gno lint ./...` clean; `gno fmt`
clean. Coverage: create + read back every field, sequential IDs, invalid
recipient (garbage, empty, bad checksum), empty/whitespace title, title and
note length limits (over-limit rejected, exactly-at-limit accepted),
revoke by issuer, revoke by non-issuer rejected, double revoke rejected,
revoke/get of nonexistent IDs, the per-recipient index, and Render output
for home, certificate detail (valid and revoked states), address page
(populated, empty, invalid), and unknown routes.

Crossing-call panics are asserted with `uassert.AbortsContains` (a crossed
panic is an abort and cannot be caught with `defer`/`recover`);
non-crossing panics (e.g. `GetCertificate`) use `uassert.PanicsContains`.

## Deploy (run later — NOT executed in the MVP task)

Prerequisites, from the deploy-proof lessons in
`~/workspace/gnome-tavern/notes/DEPLOY_PROOF.md`:

1. The local RPC relay must be running (gnokey ignores proxy env vars and
   this VM has no direct egress):

   ```bash
   nohup python3 ~/workspace/gnome-tavern/notes/rpc-relay.py > /tmp/rpc-relay.log 2>&1 &
   ```

2. Signing uses the recovered keyring — the original keyring's password
   was never recorded. Password file (0600, testnet-only throwaway):
   `~/workspace/gnome-tavern/notes/keyring-recovered-password.txt`.
   Never print the mnemonic.

Deploy command (from this directory):

```bash
cd ~/workspace/gnome-tavern/app/gnoseal
cat ~/workspace/gnome-tavern/notes/keyring-recovered-password.txt | \
~/workspace/gnome-tavern/bin/gnokey maketx addpkg \
  -pkgpath "gno.land/r/g1vh79rcwdqd7m0dlt00slwa4lppwmn6fpytd9px/gnoseal" \
  -pkgdir . \
  -gas-fee 5000ugnot -gas-wanted 5000000 \
  -chainid onyx-1 -remote http://127.0.0.1:26657 \
  -home ~/workspace/gnome-tavern/notes/keyring-recovered \
  -insecure-password-stdin \
  tavern-deployer
```

Notes for the deploy run:

- The deploy locks a storage deposit of 100 ugnot per byte on top of the
  gas fee (the proof realm locked ~0.32 GNOT); the faucet drip of 100 GNOT
  covers this easily.
- Wrap the call in a retry-on-502 loop: the relay intermittently returns
  502 ("Remote end closed connection without response"). A wrong password
  surfaces as "invalid account password" once the relay is healthy — do
  not confuse the two errors.
- After `OK!` and the tx hash, the package goes through GPAS
  (https://gpas.latest.testnets.gno.land) and is enabled on chain in slow
  batches (hours, per the proof run). Poll
  `gnokey query vm/qrender` for the realm path until it answers instead of
  expecting the gnoweb page to work immediately.
- First calls after enablement (same signing pattern):

  ```bash
  # issue a certificate
  cat ~/workspace/gnome-tavern/notes/keyring-recovered-password.txt | \
  ~/workspace/gnome-tavern/bin/gnokey maketx call \
    -pkgpath "gno.land/r/g1vh79rcwdqd7m0dlt00slwa4lppwmn6fpytd9px/gnoseal" \
    -func "CreateCertificate" \
    -args "<recipient-g1-address>" -args "<title>" -args "<note>" \
    -gas-fee 2000ugnot -gas-wanted 2000000 \
    -chainid onyx-1 -remote http://127.0.0.1:26657 \
    -home ~/workspace/gnome-tavern/notes/keyring-recovered \
    -insecure-password-stdin \
    tavern-deployer
  ```

## Design decisions beyond the original brief

- **Current toolchain APIs, not the retired `std` package.** The brief's
  `std.Address` / std caller patterns map to this toolchain's split
  packages: the builtin `address` type (validated with `IsValid()`),
  `runtime.ChainHeight()` from `chain/runtime` for the issuance height,
  and `cur.Previous().Address()` for caller identity, following the
  clone's `docs/resources/gno-interrealm.md` and its AGENTS.md security
  rules (no `chain/runtime/unsafe` stack-walking beside a `cur` param).
- **Revoke requires a non-empty reason.** The brief said the reason is
  recorded; an empty reason would defeat the product's transparency
  purpose, so it is rejected (trimmed, ≤ 280 bytes).
- **`GetCertificate` returns a copy by value**, never a pointer into realm
  storage, so no caller can hold a mutable reference to stored state.
- **Length caps in bytes** (title 120, note 560, reason 280): simple,
  deterministic, and matched by boundary tests.
- **Storage layout**: a slice for issuance order plus a
  `map[address][]uint64` index, instead of an AVL tree — v1 volumes are
  small, and the map keeps the recipient lookup O(1) without an extra
  dependency.

package parimutuel

import (
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
)

var (
	alice = testutils.TestAddress("alice")
	bob   = testutils.TestAddress("bob")
	carol = testutils.TestAddress("carol")
)

func TestBasicYesWins(t *testing.T) {
	p := New(100) // 1%
	uassert.NoError(t, p.Place(alice, Yes, 6_000_000))
	uassert.NoError(t, p.Place(bob, Yes, 2_000_000))
	uassert.NoError(t, p.Place(carol, No, 2_000_000))

	uassert.Equal(t, int64(10_000_000), p.Total())
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(8000), p.YesBps())
	uassert.Equal(t, 3, p.Bettors())

	out, err := p.Resolve(Yes)
	uassert.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.Equal(t, int(Yes), int(out))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(100_000), p.Fee())

	// net pool = 9_900_000, alice has 6/8, bob 2/8
	a, err := p.Claim(alice)
	uassert.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(7_425_000), a)

	b, err := p.Claim(bob)
	uassert.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2_475_000), b)

	_, err = p.Claim(carol)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrNothingToClaim)

	_, err = p.Claim(alice)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrAlreadyClaimed)
}

func TestEmptyWinningSideVoids(t *testing.T) {
	p := New(100)
	uassert.NoError(t, p.Place(alice, No, 1_000_000))
	out, err := p.Resolve(Yes)
	uassert.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.Equal(t, int(Void), int(out))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), p.Fee())

	amt, err := p.Claim(alice)
	uassert.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1_000_000), amt)
}

func TestOneSidedPoolNoFee(t *testing.T) {
	p := New(100)
	uassert.NoError(t, p.Place(alice, Yes, 1_000_000))
	uassert.NoError(t, p.Place(bob, Yes, 3_000_000))
	_, err := p.Resolve(Yes)
	uassert.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), p.Fee())
	a, _ := p.Claim(alice)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1_000_000), a)
}

func TestVoidRefundsBothSides(t *testing.T) {
	p := New(300)
	uassert.NoError(t, p.Place(alice, Yes, 1_000_000))
	uassert.NoError(t, p.Place(alice, No, 500_000))
	_, err := p.Resolve(Void)
	uassert.NoError(t, err)
	a, _ := p.Claim(alice)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1_500_000), a)
}

func TestGuards(t *testing.T) {
	p := New(100)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, p.Place(alice, Void, 1), ErrInvalidSide)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, p.Place(alice, Yes, 0), ErrInvalidAmount)
	_, err := p.Claim(alice)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrNotResolved)

	uassert.NoError(t, p.Place(alice, Yes, 10))
	_, err = p.Resolve(Pending)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrInvalidOutcome)
	_, err = p.Resolve(Yes)
	uassert.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = p.Resolve(No)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrAlreadyResolved)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, p.Place(bob, No, 10), ErrAlreadyResolved)
}

func TestFeeClamp(t *testing.T) {
	uassert.Equal(t, MaxFeeBps, New(9999).FeeBps())
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), New(-5).FeeBps())
}

func TestMultiplier(t *testing.T) {
	p := New(0)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), p.Multiplier(Yes))
	uassert.NoError(t, p.Place(alice, Yes, 1_000_000))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(10_000), p.Multiplier(Yes)) // one-sided: refund, 1.00x
	uassert.NoError(t, p.Place(bob, No, 3_000_000))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(40_000), p.Multiplier(Yes)) // 4.0x
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(13_333), p.Multiplier(No))  // 1.33x
}

func TestLargeNumbersNoOverflow(t *testing.T) {
	p := New(100)
	big := int64(1_000_000_000_000_000) // 1e9 GNOT in ugnot
	uassert.NoError(t, p.Place(alice, Yes, big))
	uassert.NoError(t, p.Place(bob, No, big))
	_, err := p.Resolve(Yes)
	uassert.NoError(t, err)
	a, err := p.Claim(alice)
	uassert.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1_980_000_000_000_000), a)
}

func TestParseSide(t *testing.T) {
	s, err := ParseSide("YES")
	uassert.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.Equal(t, int(Yes), int(s))
	s, err = ParseSide("no")
	uassert.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.Equal(t, int(No), int(s))
	_, err = ParseSide("maybe")
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrInvalidSide)
}

# Tavern Duel Arena

**Two gnomes walk into a tavern. One leaves with the pot.**

A commit-reveal wagering game on [Gno.land](https://gno.land). Two players stake the
same amount of GNOT on a tavern-brawl match and the winner takes the pot, minus a
small house rake. The rules live in one Gno realm, every byte of state is public,
and the game is fair because **neither player can see the other's move before
committing**.

## How it works

Moves are a classic rock-paper-scissors cycle with tavern flavor:

| Move | Emoji | Beats |
|---|---|---|
| Ale | 🍺 | Broom (spills everywhere) |
| Broom | 🧹 | Dagger (sweeps it away) |
| Dagger | 🗡️ | Ale (stabs the keg) |

Ties refund both stakes in full, with no rake.

### Fair by commitment

1. **Commit.** Each player picks a move and a random salt, computes
   `sha256("<move>:<salt>")` (hex) locally, and keeps both secret.
2. **Open.** The creator calls `CreateDuel(commitment)` sending the stake
   (native `ugnot`, between 0.001 and 1 GNOT).
3. **Join.** The opponent calls `JoinDuel(id, theirCommitment)` with the
   *exact same* stake. Neither side has seen the other's move: the commitment
   hides it until the reveal.
4. **Reveal.** Both call `RevealDuel(id, move, salt)`. The realm checks each
   reveal against the stored commitment. When the second reveal lands, the
   winner is paid `2 × stake − rake` automatically.
5. **Walkouts.** Deadlines protect your stake:
   - nobody joined: `ClaimForfeit` refunds the creator after the join window,
   - joined but silent: the player who revealed on time takes the pot,
   - nobody revealed: both stakes are refunded.

### The realm

| Function | Who | What |
|---|---|---|
| `CreateDuel(commitment)` | anyone | open a duel, sending the stake |
| `JoinDuel(id, commitment)` | anyone but the creator | match the stake with your own commitment |
| `RevealDuel(id, move, salt)` | a player | open your commitment; the second reveal resolves |
| `ClaimForfeit(id)` | anyone | settle a duel whose opponent never showed up |
| `Init()` | deployer, once | record the realm admin |
| `SetWindows(join, reveal)` | admin | tune deadlines (in blocks) |
| `SetRakeBps(bps)` | admin | tune the house rake (≤ 10%) |
| `WithdrawTreasury(to, amount)` | admin | withdraw accumulated rake |
| `Render(path)` | gnoweb | serve the UI (see below) |

Parameters: stake 0.001–1 GNOT per player, rake 2.5% (default), windows 300
blocks by default (Onyx produces a block roughly every 5 s).

## Playing

Everything is on the testnet (`onyx-1`). Read-only views need no wallet:
call `Render` through gnoweb or `gnokey query vm/qeval`.

### 1. Create your key and get test GNOT

```bash
gnokey add mykey                     # store the mnemonic safely
# faucet: https://faucet.gno.land  (paste your g1... address, pick ONYX-1)
```

### 2. Compute a commitment

Any sha256 works; the help page next to the realm does it in the browser:

```bash
printf '0:hunter2' | sha256sum       # 0=🍺 Ale, 1=🧹 Broom, 2=🗡️ Dagger
```

### 3. Create a duel (0.01 GNOT stake)

```bash
gnokey maketx call \
  -pkgpath gno.land/r/<deployer-address>/duels \
  -func CreateDuel \
  -args <your-64-hex-commitment> \
  -send 10000000ugnot \
  -gas-fee 1000000ugnot -gas-wanted 20000000 -broadcast \
  -chainid onyx-1 -remote https://rpc.onyx.testnets.gno.land:443 \
  mykey
```

### 4. Join, then reveal

```bash
# opponent: same stake, own commitment
gnokey maketx call -pkgpath gno.land/r/<addr>/duels -func JoinDuel \
  -args <duel-id> -args <your-commitment> -send 10000000ugnot ...
gnokey maketx call -pkgpath gno.land/r/<addr>/duels -func RevealDuel \
  -args <duel-id> -args 0 -args <your-salt> ...
```

After the second reveal the winner is paid already — just read the page.

### 5. Read the game

- Arena: `https://latest.testnets.gno.land/r/<addr>/duels`
- One duel: `.../duels:duel/<id>`
- Player: `.../duels:stats/<address>`
- Leaderboard: `.../duels:leaderboard`

The render pages include working forms for `RevealDuel` and `ClaimForfeit`, so
with a connected wallet you can reveal straight from the browser.

## Repository layout

```
duels.gno        the realm: game rules, payout logic, gnoweb UI
duels_test.gno   12 test cases: full flows, ties, forfeits, rejection paths, admin, render
gnomod.toml      module path and language version
web/index.html   commitment calculator + command builder (no server, open in a browser)
tools/           WSL dev scripts: fmt/lint/test, local chain, end-to-end game
```

## Testing

```bash
bash tools/check.sh     # gno fmt -w, gno lint, gno test
```

The suite covers: creator wins / joiner wins / tie, the unjoined-duel refund,
the silent-revealer forfeit, the nobody-revealed refund, commitment mismatch,
double reveal, non-player calls, wrong stake, out-of-bounds stake, unknown duels,
deadlines, admin-only functions, and the render pages for every route.

package duels

import (
	"chain"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/avl/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
)

// realmAddr is the address this realm controls on chain.
var realmAddr = chain.PackageAddress("gno.land/r/g196ke3ypjh04jts7qjez74cgsd09ufuednn2f3m/duels")

const testStake int64 = 10_000_000 // 0.01 GNOT

func testCommit(move int, salt string) string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strconv.Itoa(move) + ":" + salt))
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func stakes(amount int64) chain.Coins {
	return chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: amount}}
}

// resetAll clears realm state between tests.
func resetAll() {
	duels = avl.Tree{}
	stats = avl.Tree{}
	nextID = 0
	joinWindow = int64(defaultJoinWindow)
	revealWindow = int64(defaultRevealWindow)
	rakeBps = int64(defaultRakeBps)
	escrow = 0
	treasury = 0
	volume = 0
	duelsPlayed = 0
	admin = address("")
	hasAdmin = false
}

// initRealm runs Init as the deployer and funds the realm for payouts.
func initRealm(cur realm, t *testing.T) address {
	deployer := testutils.TestAddress("deployer")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(deployer))
	Init(cross(cur))
	uassert.Equal(t, deployer, Admin(), "admin should be the initializer")
	testing.IssueCoins(realmAddr, stakes(1_000_000_000))
	return deployer
}

// openDuel creates a duel as creator, committed to (move, salt).
func openDuel(cur realm, t *testing.T, creator address, move int, salt string, amount int64) uint64 {
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
	testing.SetOriginSend(stakes(amount))
	return CreateDuel(cross(cur), testCommit(move, salt))
}

// joinDuel joins an open duel as joiner, committed to (move, salt).
func joinDuel(cur realm, joiner address, id uint64, move int, salt string, amount int64) {
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(joiner))
	testing.SetOriginSend(stakes(amount))
	JoinDuel(cross(cur), id, testCommit(move, salt))
}

func TestFullFlowCreatorWins(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetAll()
	initRealm(cur, t)
	alice := testutils.TestAddress("alice")
	bob := testutils.TestAddress("bob")

	id := openDuel(cur, t, alice, MoveAle, "salt-a", testStake)
	d := GetDuel(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, PhaseOpen, d.phase, "duel should start open")
	uassert.Equal(t, testStake, escrow, "escrow should hold alice's stake")

	joinDuel(cur, bob, id, MoveBroom, "salt-b", testStake)
	d = GetDuel(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, PhaseReveal, d.phase, "duel should move to reveal")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2*testStake), escrow, "escrow should hold both stakes")

	// alice reveals only; nothing pays out yet.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	RevealDuel(cross(cur), id, MoveAle, "salt-a")
	d = GetDuel(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, PhaseReveal, d.phase, "duel waits for the second reveal")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2*testStake), escrow, "no payout before both reveals")

	// bob reveals; alice wins (Ale beats Broom).
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	RevealDuel(cross(cur), id, MoveBroom, "salt-b")

	pot := 2 * testStake
	rake := pot * defaultRakeBps / 10_000
	prize := pot - rake

	d = GetDuel(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, PhaseDone, d.phase, "duel should be resolved")
	uassert.Equal(t, ResultCreator, d.result, "creator should win")
	uassert.Equal(t, prize, d.payout, "payout should be pot minus rake")
	uassert.Equal(t, rake, d.rake, "rake should be booked")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), escrow, "escrow should be empty after payout")
	uassert.Equal(t, rake, treasury, "rake should sit in the treasury")
	uassert.Equal(t, pot, volume, "volume should count the pot")
	uassert.Equal(t, uint64(1), duelsPlayed, "one duel resolved")

	as := GetPlayerStats(alice)
	bs := GetPlayerStats(bob)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1), as.wins, "alice should have one win")
	uassert.Equal(t, prize, as.won, "alice's winnings should match the payout")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1), bs.losses, "bob should have one loss")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1), as.duels, "alice's duel recorded")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1), bs.duels, "bob's duel recorded")
}

func TestTieRefundsBothStakes(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetAll()
	initRealm(cur, t)
	alice := testutils.TestAddress("alice")

package admitone

import (
	"chain"
	"chain/banker"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
	"gno.land/r/g1zjumaghw5cgzhyj46eygvd452p6the6n56dppx/lamplighter/registry/v2"
)

const (
	selfTestPath = "gno.land/r/g1zjumaghw5cgzhyj46eygvd452p6the6n56dppx/admitone/v1"
	gnotU        = 1000000
)

var (
	selfAddr  = chain.PackageAddress(selfTestPath)
	organiser = testutils.TestAddress("organiser")
	ann       = testutils.TestAddress("ann")
	sam       = testutils.TestAddress("sam")
	bo        = testutils.TestAddress("bo")
	kim       = testutils.TestAddress("kim")
	lighter   = testutils.TestAddress("lighter")
)

func ugnotOf(addr address) int64 {
	return banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(addr, denom)
}

// sending attaches coins to the next call into this realm. The test banker
// does not move those coins by itself, so they are issued to the realm.
// Choosing the caller (testing.SetRealm) has to stay in the test function
// itself, because the test runtime ties it to the calling frame.
func sending(amount int64) {
	if amount == 0 {
		testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
		return
	}
	coins := chain.Coins{{denom, amount}}
	testing.IssueCoins(selfAddr, coins)
	testing.SetOriginSend(coins)
}

// checkBooks checks, for the events a test created, that the coins this realm
// holds are exactly what it owes ticket holders, and that the ticket ledger
// agrees with the events. The test runtime empties balances between test
// functions, so each test passes only its own events.
func checkBooks(t *testing.T, ids ...uint64) {
	t.Helper()
	var owed int64
	live := 0
	for _, id := range ids {
		e := mustEvent(id)
		owed += escrow(e)
		live += e.live
		n := 0
		prefix := pad(id) + "-"
		tickets.Iterate(prefix, prefix+"~", func(_ string, _ any) bool { n++; return false })
		uassert.Equal(t, e.live, n, "every live ticket of event "+utoa(id)+" is on record")
	}
	uassert.Equal(t, owed, ugnotOf(selfAddr), "the realm holds exactly the escrow of its live tickets")
}

// in returns a start time d seconds from now.
func in(d int64) int64 { return time.Now().Unix() + d }

// The demo story: a quiz night with a capped resale, admissions at the door,
// two no-shows, and a lamplighter settling it at the end.
func TestQuizNight(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	start := in(600)
	end := start + 3600

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(organiser))
	sending(LampFee)
	id := CreateEvent(cross(cur), "Quiz night", "Teams of four, bring a pencil", start, end, 1*gnotU, 20, 2, 1000, 2000)
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	job := JobOf(id)
	uassert.NotEqual(t, uint64(0), job)
	uassert.Equal(t, LampFee, registry.Balance(job), "the organiser's fee funds the job that settles the event")
	uassert.Equal(t, end, registry.NextDue(job))

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(ann))
	sending(1 * gnotU)
	a1 := Buy(cross(cur), id)
	sending(1 * gnotU)
	a2 := Buy(cross(cur), id)
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.Equal(t, "1-1", a1)
	uassert.Equal(t, ann, OwnerOf(a2))
	bal, _ := Token().BalanceOf(ann)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2), bal, "tickets are GRC721 tokens")
	checkBooks(t, id)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sam))
	sending(1 * gnotU)
	s1 := Buy(cross(cur), id)
	sending(1 * gnotU)
	s2 := Buy(cross(cur), id)
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.Equal(t, "one address may hold at most 2 tickets for this event", buyRefusal(mustEvent(id), sam, time.Now().Unix()))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "list at 0 to 1100000 ugnot: face value plus at most 10%", func() { List(cross(cur), s1, 5*gnotU) })
	List(cross(cur), s1, 1100000)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("event/1"), "## Resale desk"))
	uassert.Equal(t, "the listing opens to buyers in 60s", buyListedRefusal(mustTicket(s1), bo, time.Now().Unix()),
		"a listing cannot be bought in the transaction that posts it")
	testing.SkipHeights(13)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bo))
	samBefore := ugnotOf(sam)
	uassert.Equal(t, "send exactly 1700000 ugnot", payRefusal(chain.Coins{{denom, 1100000}}, 1100000+ResaleDeposit))
	sending(1100000 + ResaleDeposit)
	BuyListed(cross(cur), s1)
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.Equal(t, bo, OwnerOf(s1))
	uassert.Equal(t, samBefore+1100000+ResaleDeposit, ugnotOf(sam), "the seller gets the price and the deposit allowance")
	checkBooks(t, id)

	// The doors are not open yet.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(ann))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "doors open at "+when(start), func() { Admit(cross(cur), a1) })
	testing.SkipHeights(121) // 605 s: doors open

	orgBefore := ugnotOf(organiser)
	Admit(cross(cur), a1)
	uassert.Equal(t, orgBefore+1*gnotU, ugnotOf(organiser), "walking in pays the organiser")
	uassert.True(t, IsAdmitted(a1))
	uassert.True(t, Attended(id, ann))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "already admitted", func() { Admit(cross(cur), a1) })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "an admitted ticket cannot be resold", func() { List(cross(cur), a1, 0) })
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("ticket/"+a1), "ADMITTED"))

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sam))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "only the holder can do this", func() { Admit(cross(cur), a2) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bo))
	Admit(cross(cur), s1)
	checkBooks(t, id)

	// a2 and s2 never come. Nobody can refund before the end.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(ann))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "refunds open when the event is cancelled or over", func() { Refund(cross(cur), a2) })

	testing.SkipHeights(721) // past the end
	uassert.True(t, registry.IsDue(job))
	orgBefore = ugnotOf(organiser)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(lighter))
	registry.Exec(cross(cur), job)
	uassert.Equal(t, orgBefore+2*200000, ugnotOf(organiser), "settling pays the no-show fee of each unused ticket")
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "event 1 is already settled", func() { Settle(cross(cur), id) })
	checkBooks(t, id)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(ann))
	annBefore := ugnotOf(ann)
	Refund(cross(cur), a2)
	uassert.Equal(t, annBefore+800000, ugnotOf(ann), "a no-show gets the price minus the fee")
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "an admitted ticket has been used", func() { Refund(cross(cur), a1) })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, `unknown ticket "1-2"`, func() { Refund(cross(cur), a2) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sam))
	Refund(cross(cur), s2)
	checkBooks(t, id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), ugnotOf(selfAddr))
	supply := Token().TotalSupply()
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2), supply, "refunded tickets are burned; the admitted ones stay as stamps")

	// bo throws his stamp away to take back its storage deposit.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bo))
	Discard(cross(cur), s1)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1), Token().TotalSupply())
	uassert.False(t, Attended(id, bo))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("event/1"), "| At the door | 2 admitted |"), "the door count keeps discarded tickets")
	checkBooks(t, id)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(ann))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "only the organiser can reclaim the job's deposit", func() { Reclaim(cross(cur), id) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(organiser))
	Reclaim(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.False(t, registry.Exists(job))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "there is no job to reclaim", func() { Reclaim(cross(cur), id) })
}

func TestCancelRefundsEverything(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	start := in(3600)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(organiser))
	sending(LampFee)
	id := CreateEvent(cross(cur), "Rained off", "", start, start+600, 500000, 10, 3, 0, 5000)
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	job := JobOf(id)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(kim))
	sending(500000)
	k1 := Buy(cross(cur), id)
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "only the organiser can cancel the event", func() { Cancel(cross(cur), id) })

	orgBefore := ugnotOf(organiser)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(organiser))
	Cancel(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.False(t, registry.Exists(job), "cancelling the event cancels its job")
	uassert.Equal(t, orgBefore+LampFee, ugnotOf(organiser), "and the job's unspent fee goes back to the organiser")
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "the event is already cancelled", func() { Cancel(cross(cur), id) })
	checkBooks(t, id)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bo))
	uassert.Equal(t, "the event is cancelled", buyRefusal(mustEvent(id), bo, time.Now().Unix()))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "event 2 was cancelled", func() { Settle(cross(cur), id) })

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(kim))
	kimBefore := ugnotOf(kim)
	Refund(cross(cur), k1)
	uassert.Equal(t, kimBefore+500000, ugnotOf(kim), "a cancelled event refunds the full price, no-show fee or not")
	checkBooks(t, id)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("event/"+utoa(id)), "This event was cancelled"))
}

// A free event is an RSVP list with an attendance stamp.
func TestFreeEvent(cur realm, t *testing.T) {

}

func TestCreateRules(cur realm, t *testing.T) {

		{"name must be 1 to 60 bytes of printable text", checkEvent("a\u0085b", "", s, s+600, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, n)},
		{"details must be at most 280 bytes of printable text", checkEvent("x", "  ", s, s+600, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, n)},
		{"start must be between now and a year from now", checkEvent("x", "", s-1200, s, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, n)},
		{"an event lasts 1 minute to 90 days", checkEvent("x", "", s, s+59, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, n)},
		{"price must be 0 to 1000000000000 ugnot", checkEvent("x", "", s, s+600, -1, 1, 1, 0, 0, n)},
		{"capacity must be 1 to 1000", checkEvent("x", "", s, s+600, 0, 1001, 1, 0, 0, n)},

		{"noShowBps must be 0 to 10000", checkEvent("x", "", s, s+600, 0, 5, 1, 0, 10001, n)},
		{"", checkEvent("x", "", s, s+600, 0, 5, 1, 0, 0, n)},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		uassert.Equal(t, c.msg, c.got)

// The guards the escrow promise rests on: no cancelling once the event has
// started, and a cancelled event refunds listed tickets in full too.
func TestCancelGuards(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	start := in(120)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(organiser))
	id := CreateEvent(cross(cur), "Guarded", "", start, start+600, 400000, 5, 2, 0, 0)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(kim))
	sending(400000)
	k := Buy(cross(cur), id)
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	List(cross(cur), k, 400000)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(organiser))
	Cancel(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(Render("event/"+utoa(id)), "## Resale desk"), "a cancelled event shows no desk")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(kim))
	kimBefore := ugnotOf(kim)
	Refund(cross(cur), k)
	uassert.Equal(t, kimBefore+400000, ugnotOf(kim), "a listed ticket of a cancelled event is refunded in full")
	checkBooks(t, id)

	start = in(60)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(organiser))
	id2 := CreateEvent(cross(cur), "Started", "", start, start+600, 0, 5, 1, 0, 0)
	testing.SkipHeights(13)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "an event that has started cannot be cancelled", func() { Cancel(cross(cur), id2) })
}

// still completes, pays its runner, and leaves the queue.
func TestManualSettleLetsTheJobFinish(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	start := in(60)

	id := CreateEvent(cross(cur), "Early bird", "", start, start+60, 0, 5, 1, 0, 0)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(kim))

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(lighter))
	registry.Exec(cross(cur), job)
	uassert.Equal(t, lighterBefore+LampFee, ugnotOf(lighter), "the runner is still paid")
	uassert.True(t, registry.Done(job))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(organiser))
	Reclaim(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.False(t, registry.Exists(job))
}
